item.title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 ‘A Painted Symphony’ Officially Returns in 2027
item.description: Following a sold-out European tour earlier this year, A Painted Symphony is coming back in 2027 with even more dates and locations. The concert series for Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 will get an encore performance next year with a global tour including the first ever performances in North America. The world tour was announced today with tickets going on sale Sept. 15. It will include Europe, the United Kingdom, and the United States. Fans in Asia, Africa, Australia, and South America are out of luck this time around.

item.title: Robert Pattinson's Forgotten Dark Fantasy Thriller Proves He's a Perfect James Bond
item.description: Not everybody is convinced Robert Pattinson is the right choice to be the next James Bond. Some are complaining Bond should be played by someone less famous , like he has in the past. Others feel he’s not masculine enough , or good-looking enough, or charismatic enough . Most of all, though, it seems many people don't love the idea that “the Twilight guy” is playing Bond.

item.title: 34 Years Later, the Best 'Far Side' Quote Will Still Leave You Speechless
item.description: Larson didn’t do deep and inspirational. Many of his cartoons required you to think, but not because they were thoughtful . Larson’s work was brilliant, and it sometimes took a few minutes to figure out what the punchline was. Take, this comic strip where an artist is painting a woman as a half-fly creature, for example. You likely see the woman or the painting first, and you wonder why the artist is painting her that way. Only after inspecting the comic more closely do you see the dead fly stuck to his glasses.

item.title: Star Wars Is Getting an Official IMAX 70mm Release for the First Time
item.description: Han will shoot first in 70 mm IMAX when the original Star Wars returns to movie theaters next year. Lucasfilm and IMAX have confirmed that the 50th anniversary rerelease of Star Wars will be on the biggest screens possible next February, giving fans a strong reason to return to theaters.

item.title: GTA 6 Is Getting Review Bombed in Zelda vs. GTA Troll War
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 may be the highest-rated game of all time on Metacritic , and may have earned a record-breaking $3.79 billion on launch day , but that doesn't mean Rockstar Games' new blockbuster can't have its haters. Multiple groups have descended on GTA 6 's Metacritic page to attack the game for its perceived shortcomings, much of that criticism is based on culture war nonsense.

item.title: Netflix’s (Very) R-Rated 45-Episode Sci-Fi Anthology Doesn’t Get the Attention It Deserves
item.description: Almost four decades after the film’s release, filmmakers David Fincher and Tim Miller attempted to reboot Heavy Metal , which eventually morphed into the Netflix sci-fi anthology, Love, Death & Robots . Although the series inevitably carries the DNA of Heavy Metal and its contemporaries, Love, Death & Robots carves out its distinct identity over 45 exceptional episodes. While sci-fi is at the heart of these anthology tales, the show blends everything from horror to comedy to complement the bountiful art styles that are a celebration of animation as a medium.

item.title: 25 Years Later, Dragon Quest’s Island-Hopping Epic Gets Better in Every Port
item.description: The Dragon Quest franchise has been around for longer than some of us have been alive, and its first entry in 1986 was one of the JRPG genre’s pioneers. Over the years, the launch of a new title in the series has been a big deal, especially in Japan. Before players missed work to play Grand Theft Auto 6 , they were using sick days to topple wicked dragonlords.

item.title: Sorry, Vice City, but You’re the Most Boring Part of GTA 6
item.description: When Grand Theft Auto 6 was first announced, fans were thrilled at the prospect of returning to Vice City. The Miami-inspired location has always been one of the series’ most memorable locations, its neon-lit streets standing in contrast to the grittiness of Liberty City. While I was as excited as anyone to go clubbing and spend some time on the beach, after 70 hours, GTA 6 has struck me with one surprise thought: Vice City is the least interesting part of Leonida.

item.title: GTA 6's T-shirts Are True Works of Art
item.description: We've known for some time that fashion would be a big deal in Grand Theft Auto 6 . In Rockstar's official promotional materials for the game, both Jason and Lucia were prominently featured wearing stylish clothing, from Lucia's body-hugging gold dress to Jason's slick Miami Vice -inspired aqua sport coat. Even supporting characters like Brian wear Tommy Bahama-inspired aloha shirts yanked straight from the closet of a dapper middle-aged stoner. GTA 6 has drawn praise from all quarters for its scrupulous attention to detail in every aspect of the game, and there's one area the developer went far, far harder than it needed to: the vast and immaculate selection of T-shirts.

item.title: How to steal the BF Bandito in GTA 6
item.description: You need to find a way to steal the BF Bandito in Grand Theft Auto 6 to help out Moses. After completing the first batch of requests, Moses will contact you about other cars he wants you to retrieve for him. Among them is this off-road beast. Unlike the Declasse Vamos , you won't need to figure out how to move the BF Bandito out of a garage. The challenge this time is to actually make the target stop.
